summary: Initial release of PlainLaw — Legal Reference. Submitted to Google Play (in review) and Apple App Store. Comprehensive offline legal reference covering US law, international law, courts, and legal tools.
included: Know Your Rights guides for everyday legal situations across 10+ categories
Legal dictionary with 1,000+ plain-language definitions
Jurisdiction selector — auto-detects your location and shows relevant laws
Practice area guides: criminal, civil, family, employment, immigration, real estate, corporate
State-by-state law comparisons across all 50 states (Premium)
Full US Constitution with annotations — all 27 amendments (Pro)
Complete Federal Rules of Civil Procedure (FRCP) and Federal Rules of Evidence (FRE) (Pro)
50 landmark SCOTUS cases with plain-English summaries (Pro)
Federal court directory — all 94 district courts + 13 circuit courts (Pro)
State court systems — all 50 states with contact info and procedures (Pro)
Judicial profiles — current SCOTUS justices with background and notable opinions (Pro)
International law — UN, ICC, UNCLOS, WTO, regional courts and 15-country legal profiles (Pro)
Legal calculators: statute of limitations, deadline calculator, damages estimator (Premium)
Citation reference guide with Bluebook and court-specific formats (Premium)
Circuit split tracker — active disagreements between federal circuits (Pro)
Legal writing guide with templates and citation formats (Pro)
Legal quiz and flashcards for law students
Evidence organizer and checklist tracker
Small claims guide for self-represented litigants
Contract explainer with plain-language breakdowns
Three-tier access: Free, Premium ($4.99 one-time), Pro (subscription)
Google Play Billing (Android) and StoreKit 2 (iOS) integration
100% offline — no data collection, no tracking, no accounts required
36 Android screens, 38 iOS views
